title: OpenStax Biology 2e 16.4 Eukaryotic Transcription Gene Regulation
text: In some eukaryotic genes, there are additional regions that help increase or enhance transcription. These regions, called enhancers, are not necessarily close to the genes they enhance. They can be located upstream of a gene, within the coding region of the gene, downstream of a gene, or may be thousands of nucleotides away.
missingExcerpts: An enhancer is a DNA sequence that promotes transcription.
